headline: Remove objects from images
summary: Draw around anything in an image and RefBoard paints it out from what is around it. Plus new alignment options, and updates that reopen the app.

new.title: Remove object
new.description: Select an image, choose Remove object in the selection bar or the right-click menu, and draw around what should go. Remove as many things as you like, then press Enter to apply or Esc to cancel. The first use downloads a 208 MB model once, and it needs a graphics card with WebGPU.

new.title: Align rows left, center or right
new.description: Select rows of items and line up their starts, middles or ends on one vertical line.

new.title: Label alignment
new.description: Labels under items can sit on the left, in the center or on the right. Choose it in Labels, under Display.

improved.title: Security update
improved.description: RefBoard now runs on Electron 44.9.3, which no longer trusts a compromised certificate authority.

fixed.title: RefBoard reopens after an update
fixed.description: After Restart to update, the update installs and RefBoard comes back on its own.
